The perspective looks down a central corridor flanked by cells with vertical iron bars on both the left and right sides. The floor is concrete, and the ceiling is arched with a hanging light fixture in the foreground. At the far end of the corridor, there is a solid door or wall section illuminated by a bright light source from above, creating a high-contrast focal point. The atmosphere is stark, utilitarian, and imposing.
